# travelnow.info

> Visa requirements for every passport, shown on an interactive globe, with tools for trip planning. The data is
> compiled from public sources (mainly Wikipedia's visa-requirement tables and official government advisories) and
> refreshed daily by an automated job. The site is informational and is not an official source or a visa service:
> always confirm a requirement with the destination country's embassy or official portal before you travel.

Pages are available in English; many also have a Turkish twin under /tr/. The interface offers five more languages.

## Main tools
- [Visa globe](https://travelnow.info/): pick a passport and see the entry requirement for every destination.
- [Itinerary planner](https://travelnow.info/itinerary/): add stops on a globe and see the visas each one needs, with costs where known, lead times and the order to apply in.
- [Transit map](https://travelnow.info/transit-map/): which airport hubs you can connect through without a transit visa for your passport.
- [Safety map](https://travelnow.info/safety-map/): countries coloured by official U.S. and Canadian government travel advisories.
- [Schengen 90/180 calculator](https://travelnow.info/schengen-calculator/): days used and days left in the Schengen Area.
- [Passport validity checker](https://travelnow.info/passport-validity/): per-destination rules on how long a passport must remain valid.

## Reference pages
- [Passport pages](https://travelnow.info/passport/): one page per passport with the visa-free, visa-on-arrival, e-visa and visa-required lists.
- [ETIAS](https://travelnow.info/etias/) and [ESTA rules](https://travelnow.info/esta-rules/): pre-travel authorisation schemes.
- [Digital nomad visas](https://travelnow.info/digital-nomad-visa/) and [citizenship by investment](https://travelnow.info/citizenship-by-investment/): programme overviews.
- [Transit visa checker](https://travelnow.info/transit-visa/) and [visa shortcuts](https://travelnow.info/visa-shortcuts/): entry shortcuts for holders of a US, UK, Irish or Schengen visa.
- [Guides](https://travelnow.info/guides/): explainers, including [how the data is counted](https://travelnow.info/guides/how-we-count/).
